children: L3Harris Technologies said it had received orders worth a combined $121 million for a low-cost data radio solution for the U.S. Army.
The company said the orders for a LOCODA solution are designed to support Army Command and Control requirements.

"Our LOCODA solution leverages existing installation kits to rapidly field an enhanced version of vehicle communications, which allow battlefield commanders to access Army Command and Control applications with multiple transport options from a single platform quickly and with minimal training," said Chris Aebli, the company's president of communications and spectrum dominance.
